extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent searchers, patent attorneys, inventors preparing filings (medical/pharmaceutical containers and delivery devices)
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts and explains the Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) A61J subclass headings and explanatory notes describing containers and devices specially adapted for medical or pharmaceutical purposes, and related devices for administering medicines, feeding, teats, feeding-tubes, baby comforters, and identification/adaptation features used for patent classification and prior-art searching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Containers specially adapted for medical or pharmaceutical purposes (A61J 1/00)
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers specially adapted for medical or pharmaceutical purposes; devices or methods specially adapted for bringing pharmaceutical products into particular physical or administering forms; devices for administering food or medicines orally; baby comforters; devices for receiving spittle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-limiting references may still be displayed. Cross-references: capsules or the like for oral use A61J 3/07; surgical or diagnostic appliances A61B 50/30; containers for radioactive substances G21F 5/00. Use related groups for complete searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Containers for pills or tablets
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers specifically for pills or tablets, including containers for pills or tablets with special dispensing means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Related classification: blister-type containers (B65D 75/36). Consider dispensing means classifications (B65D 83/04).

rubrics_metrics.name: Containers for collecting, storing or administering blood, plasma or medical fluids
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers for collecting, storing or administering blood, plasma or medical fluids including multiple bag systems for separating or storing blood components and infusion or perfusion containers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-reference multiple bag systems A61M 1/0209 and infusion/perfusion container groups where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ampoules or carpules
rubrics_metrics.description: Ampoules or carpules (including syringe ampoules or carpules); Carpules; rigid ampoules (e.g., glass); flexible ampoules the contents of which are expelled by squeezing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish rigid vs. flexible ampoules; note carpules as a distinct subgroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bag-type containers
rubrics_metrics.description: Bag-type containers for medical or pharmaceutical use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes flexible-container constructions and related fittings; cross-check with infusion container groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Details; accessories for containers (A61J 1/14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Details and accessories for containers, e.g., septums, pierceable membranes, containers with closing means (caps), locking means, threaded type, snap-fit type, permanent type (welded or glued).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Group A61J 7/00 takes precedence for some accessories; examples show many particular accessory types to guide classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Septums, pierceable membranes
rubrics_metrics.description: Septums or pierceable membranes used as container closures or access points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant for vials, multi-compartment containers, and devices designed for needle access or piercing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Containers with closing means and locking means
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers with closing means (e.g., caps) including locking means requiring key or combination to open, and closure types such as threaded, snap-fit, or permanent (welded/glued).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Locking mechanisms intended for security/tamper prevention are separately noted; classify by closure mechanism characteristics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Containers with means for dispensing liquid medicaments in filtered or sterile way
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers designed to dispense liquid medicaments using bacterial filters or other filtering means (air filters or liquid filters).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish between air filtration and liquid filtration; sterile dispensing features are emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Containers with provisions for hanging
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers with provisions for hanging, e.g., integral adaptations of the container (accessories for hanging the container).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes features that facilitate suspension during use or storage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Containers characterised by specific material properties
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers defined or classified by particular material properties (e.g., biodegradable, insulating).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material-specific claims may change classification; consider material property groups (2200-series) for more detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inlet or outlet ports and connection retaining means
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers having inlet or outlet ports, with connection retaining means such as threads or snap-fit, friction fit (connecting tubes directly to a protruding port), or other connection types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify by type of connection and whether shape/structure supports tubing or connectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Containers with shape-retaining means
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers with shape-retaining means to support the structure during emptying or filling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structural supports, ribs, frames, or stiffening features intended to preserve container geometry during use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Holders for containers (A61J 1/16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Holders, supports or stands specifically adapted to hold medical/pharmaceutical containers; includes cooled holders e.g., for medications, insulin, blood or plasma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-reference reclassification warnings; cooled holders may fall into reclassified groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrangements for indicating condition of container contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Arrangements that indicate the condition of container contents, such as sterile condition indicators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes visual indicators, sensors, or other signalling means to reflect sterility, integrity, or other condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrangements for transferring or mixing fluids (vial to syringe etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Arrangements for transferring or mixing fluids, e.g., from vial to syringe; includes piercing means, separating means, peelable seals, frangible parts, alignable openings, separation clips, valve means, removable plugs, slits, connecting means, taps and directional valves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes combinations of vial and syringe for transferring/mixing contents (A61J 1/2096) and devices having multiple piercing ends; classify by number of piercing ends and transfer mechanism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venting and filtering means
rubrics_metrics.description: Venting means (internal or external), filtering means for gas or fluid filtration used in container transfer/mixing arrangements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish internal vs external venting; specify type of filter (gas vs fluid) and placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Containers or vials joinable to mix contents; multi-compartment containers
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers or vials intended to be joined to each other to mix their contents; containers having several compartments for products to be mixed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes combinations of vial and syringe for transferring or mixing contents, and containers with compartments separated by seals/frangible elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Means for metering the amount of fluid
rubrics_metrics.description: Features that meter or control the amount of fluid dispensed from a container or in a transfer arrangement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metering mechanisms and calibrated dispensing features fall under this rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Devices or methods specially adapted for bringing pharmaceutical products into particular forms (A61J 3/00)
rubrics_metrics.description: Devices or methods for converting pharmaceutical products into powders, ointments, pills, lozenges, dragees, capsules, wafers, cachets, suppositories, sticks, compressed tablets, and related manufacturing/filling apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-references: pulverising B02C; tablet presses B30B 11/00; coating operations B01J 2/006; printing on tablets B41F 17/36.

rubrics_metrics.name: Features specific to capsules and capsule manufacturing/filling
rubrics_metrics.description: Forming capsules including telescopically engaged two-piece capsules, sealing capsules for tamper-proofing, manually operated filling apparatus, manufacturing capsule shells and related operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include sealing/tamper-proof features and manufacturing process machinery when classifying capsule-related inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Devices for administering medicines orally; feeding bottles; teats; devices for receiving spittle (A61J 7/00)
rubrics_metrics.description: Devices for administering medicines orally (spoons, pill counters), arrangements for time indication/reminder for taking medicine, pill-breaking/crushing devices, trays, sticks, straws, cups, bottles or bags, oral syringes/pipettes, swallow-helping devices, and medicament distribution means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes time-based dispensers (timers, electronic history memory), programmed dispensers, and devices interacting directly with dispensing/delivery systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pill counting and timed reminder/dispensing devices
rubrics_metrics.description: Pill counting devices and arrangements for time indication or reminders (timers, scheduled/automated dispensers, electronic memory, count-down types; devices that respond to schedule deviations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify by automation level: manual, schedule-based, automatic response to deviation, multi-patient or multi-drug dispensing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anti-dispensing and patient-safety features
rubrics_metrics.description: Devices preventing drug dispensing during predetermined time periods, dispensing for multiple drugs or multiple patients, and protective caps, puncturing tools, seal-rupturing means, and leak-prevention means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes child safety, tamper prevention, and controlled dispensing mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feeding-tubes for therapeutic purposes (A61J 15/00)
rubrics_metrics.description: Feeding-tubes, including nasal/oral feeding-tubes, tubes inserted using guide-wires/pull-wires/sheaths; parts, details and accessories; means for fixing the tube inside the body (balloons, retaining means, bolsters), retainers to prevent slipping, expandable retainers, inflatable balloons, means for fixing outside the body, fixing at intermediate positions, fixing means integral with tube, tubes feeding to intestines, multi-lumen tubes, feeding pumps, and sensor means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-reference A61M groups for insertion tools/methods; note sensors for reflux, acidity, pressure and other patient/device parameters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feeding-bottles in general (A61J 9/00)
rubrics_metrics.description: Feeding bottles with inner liners, vacuum bottles, non-rigid or collapsible bottles, elongated tubes for upright drinking, storage compartments (e.g., for teats), thermometers, means for supplying air, holders for bottles, and aesthetic features (toy-like or imitating a breast).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes supports, protective covers and lids; classify by structural support (supported by infant/caregiver/self-supporting base) and attachment capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teats (A61J 11/00)
rubrics_metrics.description: Teats with additional ports for syringes or straws, varied openings by size/shape, valves, flow regulation means, filters, means for incorporating mother's scent, particular shape/structure (angled), aesthetic properties, flexibility/rigidity improvements (anti-collapse, anti-bite-through), imitation of nipple, soothing properties, orthodontic properties, and accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate classifications for flow control, orthodontic features, scented or therapeutic additions, and protective/accessory components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Baby-comforters; teething rings (A61J 17/00)
rubrics_metrics.description: Baby comforters and teething rings possibly emitting sound, light, scents or flavours; emitting sound (rattles/music), emitting light, temperature sensing, nipple attachments, orthodontic properties, decorative elements, holders, conjoined cushions/toys, straps/cords/chains, and protective covers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes consumer-oriented features and safety/accessory components; classify by emitted features and functional attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Devices for receiving spittle (A61J 19/00)
rubrics_metrics.description: Devices such as spittoons, sputum flasks, spittoons with water supply, and combustible sputum cups (including dental spittoons).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes specialized medical receptacles for expectorate handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: General characteristics or adaptations (2200/00 series)
rubrics_metrics.description: General characteristics or adaptations for medical/pharmaceutical containers: coring prevention means (for plug/septum piercing), extrusion means for producing pharmaceutical forms, compliance analysis for taking medication, heating/cooling/insulating means, biodegradable materials, device-provided sensors or indicating means (temperature, weight, fluid level).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 2200-series for general technological adaptations that cut across product-specific groups; includes environmental control (heating/cooling) and compliance/monitoring features.

rubrics_metrics.name: General identification or selection means (2205/00 series)
rubrics_metrics.description: Identification or selection means such as bar codes, colour codes, printed labels, identification by shape/form (shape recognition), using icons or symbolic figures, magnetic or electronic identifications (chips, RFID, electronic tags), and audible labels (pre-recorded info or messages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to labelling, identification, patient selection, electronic tracking and audible information systems for medications and devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warnings and cross-reference guidance for classification searches
rubrics_metrics.description: Warnings that some groups (e.g., A61J 1/10, A61J 1/12, A61J 1/16, A61J 1/165) are incomplete or impacted by reclassification into other groups (e.g., C12N 5/54–5/548) and that multiple groups should be considered to perform a complete search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When performing classification or prior-art searches, consider related CPC/IPC groups and reclassification notes to ensure comprehensive coverage.
